metadata.case_name: CHUNG CHI WING v. SECRETARY FOR JUSTICE

plaintiff.occupation_before: Fireman employed by the Fire Services Department
plaintiff.occupation_after: Unemployed (at time of trial depended on public assistance)

injuries.description: Impingement of the tendon in his right shoulder
source: sustain a very painful sprain to his right shoulder which was later discovered to be an impinged tendon.
shoulder arthroscopy which revealed an impinged tendon.
He confirms that the Plaintiff is suffering from impingement of the tendon in his right shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of muscle or tendon of the rotator cuff of shoulder

manifestations.description: Very painful sprain / severe pain in right shoulder
Stiffness of the right shoulder / severe joint stiffness

treatments_received: manipulation of the shoulder joint under general anaesthesia (June 1994)
treatments_future: repeat shoulder arthroscopy (as suggested by Dr. Lau)
decompression / tendon repair if impingement / tendon rupture identified

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (agreed as HK$350,000.00).

Past and future loss of earnings including loss of chance of promotion (agreed amounts: HK$14,505.00 for loss of chance of promotion; HK$228,120.00 loss of earnings Apr 1997-Mar 1998; HK$38,020.00 loss of earnings Apr-May 1998; loss of future earnings agreed at HK$1,452,600.00).
Loss of subsidised housing (agreed at HK$140,460.00).
